recognize_zh: 中央濾泡的生發中心偏小、淡染，周圍套區小淋巴球排成一圈圈同心圓的「洋蔥皮」（onion skinning）樣式，濾泡間有增生的血管，這是 Castleman 病的典型結構線索。
features: Follicle with a small, pale, relatively depleted (regressed-appearing) germinal center
Expanded mantle zone with small lymphocytes arranged in concentric rings (onion-skin pattern)
Interfollicular areas with increased vascularity and scattered small vessels with plump endothelium
Additional follicles with pale germinal centers at the edge of the field; congested vascular spaces in the interfollicular region
Lymph node architecture preserved without sheets of atypical cells
describe_en: Lymph node section at medium power shows preserved architecture with a follicle containing a small, pale germinal center surrounded by an expanded mantle zone in which small lymphocytes are arranged in concentric layers (onion skinning). The interfollicular region shows increased vascularity. No atypical large cell population is seen in this field. The findings are consistent with Castleman disease-type morphology; correlation with clinical criteria, plasma cell and HHV-8 (LANA-1) studies is required to classify as idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, but HHV-8 MCD shows LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zone, which are absent in iMCD.
MCL expands mantles with monotonous cyclin D1+/CD5+ cells, whereas Castleman mantles are reactive, polytypic and cyclin D1-negative.
Reactive follicles have large polarized germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and ordinary mantles, lacking concentric onion-skin layering.

ddx.dx: Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma or angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show atypical FDC or T-cell proliferations with clonal features, not bland concentric mantle lymphocytes.
